data.title: 篝之雾枝 · 古堡王座上的鲜血邀约
data.description: 蛛网与烛火交织的阴暗大厅中，雾枝优雅地斜倚在高背天鹅绒王座上。她摇晃着盛有暗红液体的水晶高脚杯，染血的薄唇扬起冰冷的弧度，向跪在阶下的俘虏投下命令般的目光。
data.location: grand decaying Victorian gothic hall with stone arches, spiderwebs, and crystal chandeliers
data.action: reclining imperiously on tufted black velvet throne, swirling blood-red liquid in ornate goblet, looking down with icy commanding beauty
data.lighting: flickering candelabra flame casting dancing sinister shadows across stone masonry
data.mood: haughty vampire dominance, dark aristocratic elegance, chilling seductive power
data.promptProse: Sitting on an ornate velvet throne in a gothic hall, black-haired Kirie swirls red wine in a crystal glass, staring down with imperious cold eyes.
data.animaCaption: Kagari no Kirie reigning from her gothic throne with a goblet of crimson wine.
